extensionDescription.message: Hide distracting Instagram sections, redirect your feed, and set daily limits for Reels and feed browsing.

hideHelp.message: Hide sections you do not want to see while browsing Instagram.

limitsHelp.message: Set daily or feed limits to prevent endless scrolling.

redirectHelp.message: Always open the Following feed instead of suggested content.

redirectOption.message: Redirect For you feed to Following

aboutDescription.message: This extension tries to give the power back to the users to use social media for what it was created for: see and follow who you want without falling into an endless black hole of meaningless content.

maintainedBy.message: InstaBrake is maintained and further developed by

derivedFrom.message: It is derived from the original MIT-licensed project created by

contributorsPrefix.message: You can find the InstaBrake contributors

privacyText.message: InstaBrake will never track you. It’s free. It only needs ‘storage’ permissions to save your options.

scrollLimitMessage.message: You have reached the configured limit of $COUNT$ posts in the Following feed.

reelsLimitMessage.message: You have watched all $COUNT$ videos allowed today. Take a break!
